subject: exeuctor: add a helper variable to help ga hash join v2 step by step for all kinds of join types (#57116)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. It adds a GA predicate (`PhysicalHashJoin.isGAForHashJoinV2`) and a global override flag (`joinversion.UseHashJoinV2ForNonGAJoin`) but, in this commit, `PhysicalHashJoin.CanUseHashJoinV2()` remains functionally equivalent to the pre-change checks (inner/left/right outer join with no NA keys, not cross join, and no NullEQ). No Blocker/High correctness/SQL-semantics issues found within the touched planner/executor paths.
